title: UK to create new ‘school of government’ to train senior civil servants
summary: Establishment will give training in AI and other skills, more than a decade after David Cameron axed previous school Ministers will bring in a new “school of government” for senior civil servants to train them in AI and other skills – more than a decade after David Cameron axed the previous college for Whitehall. Darren Jones, the chief secretary to the prime minister, will announce the new body in a speech on Tuesday setting out the government’s plans to “rewire” the civil service for modern times.
